items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Walter Johnson replaces Cutlett Cappa in '36.

ctx.x: Yeah, Roy, Chu, we had a helluva band there. We had a helluva band before they came in but Smack wanted Roy and Chu and Buster was always there. And Slick Jones.

He comes in a little later. Talking about the greatest drummer in the world, aren't you? Uh huh. An intelligent drummer, better believe it. So what happened, we hit Chicago so we do this and talk to Baby about Ed Fox, the Grand Terrace, and it takes me right back to Webster Groves, right between Webster Groves and St. Louis. That was a man who had tremendous ideas about the way he wanted everything to be seen in this cabaret. That was his home, he meant it. He meant it all the way. And, so one day they called,…
